start: Owner on the Diet plans page of an online gym with no plans yet

steps.action: Open "Diet plans" from the menu
user_sees: Title "Diet plans", line "Send members what to eat"
Button "+ New plan"
"No diet plans yet" / "Start from a ready-made plan, like “Fat loss veg · 1,600 kcal”, change what you like, and send it to members or to everyone on a membership plan."
must_not: An endless "Loading…"
Plans of another gym

steps.action: Tap "+ New plan"
user_sees: Sheet "New diet plan"
Groups "Veg" ("No eggs, meat or fish") and "Non-veg" ("With eggs, chicken or fish")
"Start empty" ("Write every meal yourself")
The note that each ready-made plan is for an adult of about 60 to 70 kg who trains 3 to 5 days a week, uses everyday Indian food and is not medical advice
must_not: A ready-made plan with meat under "Veg"

steps.action: Tap a ready-made plan
user_sees: Editor "New diet plan" filled in: "Plan name", "Goal (optional)", "Calories a day (optional)", "Protein a day (optional)", one block per meal with "Meal" and "Food, one per line", "Notes for the member (optional)", and the part that picks who gets it
must_not: An empty editor
The plan already sent to someone before saving

steps.action: Change a meal, pick who gets it, tap "Save plan"
user_sees: "Saving…", the sheet closes, the plan is in the list with "Edit", "Make a copy" and "Withdraw"
must_not: Two plans from one tap
The plan sent to members who were not picked
The meals saved in another order

start: Owner on the Diet plans page

steps.action: Tap "+ New plan", then "Start empty"
user_sees: Editor "New diet plan" with empty boxes and one meal block
Example words in the boxes ("Fat loss veg · 1,600 kcal", "Breakfast", "2 roti / 1 bowl dal / 1 bowl sabzi")
must_not: The example words saved as real content

steps.action: Fill a name and one meal, tap the button that adds “Talk to a doctor if you have a health condition.” to the notes, tap "Save plan"
user_sees: The plan in the list
must_not: The doctor line added twice

start: Owner on the Diet plans page with one saved plan

steps.action: Tap "Edit" on the plan, change the calories, tap "Save changes"
user_sees: Sheet "Edit diet plan"; after saving, the same plan with the new number
must_not: A second plan made
The people who get it reset

steps.action: Tap "Make a copy" on the plan
user_sees: Editor "New diet plan" filled with the copy
must_not: The copy saved before "Save plan" is tapped
The copy overwriting the first plan

start: Owner on the Diet plans page, editor open

steps.action: Tap "Save plan" with the name empty
user_sees: "Give the plan a name, like “Fat loss veg”."
must_not: A plan saved with no name

steps.action: Give a name but no food
user_sees: "Add the food for at least one meal (one food per line)."
must_not: An empty plan sent to members

steps.action: Type food in a meal with no meal name; type calories of 5
user_sees: "Each meal with food needs a name, like “Breakfast”."
"Calories a day: a whole number from {min} to {max}, or leave it empty."
must_not: The sheet closing with the error unread

steps.action: Open the page on a gym that is not online, and on a gym whose server lacks diet plans
user_sees: "Diet plans need your gym online" / "Members’ phones read the plans from your gym’s server. Put your gym online first (Settings → Sign-in & data)."
"Diet plans are not switched on for your gym yet" / "They will appear here once your gym’s server has them."
No "+ New plan" button
must_not: A "+ New plan" button that can never save

start: Owner on the Diet plans page with a plan that members have

steps.action: Tap "Withdraw" on the plan
user_sees: Sheet "Withdraw this plan?": "<plan name> will stop showing in members’ apps the next time they open the Gym tab. You can’t send this plan again; make a copy of it instead."
Buttons "Keep it" and "Withdraw"
must_not: The plan withdrawn on the first tap

steps.action: Tap "Keep it", then "Withdraw" again and confirm
user_sees: A toast "Plan withdrawn."
The plan under "Withdrawn plans (1)" with "Members no longer get these." and only "Make a copy"
must_not: Members still see the plan after they open the Gym tab
An "Edit" or send button on a withdrawn plan

steps.action: Tap "Make a copy" on the withdrawn plan and save it
user_sees: A new open plan; the withdrawn one stays withdrawn
must_not: The withdrawn plan coming back to members by itself

start: Owner on the Diet plans page

steps.action: Save a plan for two named members only, then open the app of a third member
user_sees: The third member sees no diet plan; the two see it under Gym → Diet plan
must_not: A member seeing a plan sent to someone else by name
A ready-made plan shown without the "not medical advice" note
Other gyms' plans or members in the picker
